text: For us to get the deposit back, the clerk told us to write a letter explaining "why" we needed the money back and "why" they should give...funny isnt it? It is like do I really have to explain why I need my 30K back? Anyway, write a letter saying that has been a long time, etc...My husband even asked his sister that writes well to write for him. It has to be in hebrew. We got our back like this with a well written letter. So good luck. Dont send by email. Go in person with the letter writen on paper and put all your information on the letter. Hand in person!!! Emails wont solve your problem. But they just gave the money back I think after 3 years....although we asked before that...they did not give...
